Name: Send Mail HTML
Author: admin
Description: Send an email with HTML template content, Send to field is comma separated. Note: Sender's display name can be configured in the client under the account settings

Parameters.Description: Recipient email address. Multiple addresses can be separated by commas
CC email address. Multiple addresses can be separated by commas
BCC email address. Multiple addresses can be separated by commas
Full path to attachments to be uploaded. Comma sepreated. e.g. C:\Desktop\x.txt,C:\Desktop\sample.txt

AIDescription:
Sends an email with HTML template content using Microsoft Exchange. This action allows for rich-text communication, including embedded images and file attachments. It supports multiple recipients across the 'To', 'CC', and 'BCC' fields.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Subject | String | Yes | The subject line of the email. If the length exceeds 255 characters, it is automatically trimmed. |
| Send to | String | Yes | A comma-separated list of recipient email addresses. |
| Mail content | String (HTML) | Yes | The HTML body of the email. Supports embedded images via specific tags. |
| CC | String | No | A comma-separated list of CC email addresses. |
| BCC | String | No | A comma-separated list of BCC email addresses. |
| Attachments Paths | String | No | A comma-separated list of full local file paths to be uploaded as attachments. |

### Flow Description
1. **Parameter Extraction:** The action retrieves the subject, recipients, HTML content, and optional CC/BCC/Attachment paths from the input.
2. **Subject Validation:** It checks the subject length and trims it to 255 characters if it exceeds the limit to comply with Exchange standards.
3. **Attachment Parsing:** It splits the comma-separated attachment paths into a list and verifies their existence.
4. **Manager Initialization:** It initializes the Exchange Manager using the integration's configuration (Server Address, Credentials, etc.).
5. **Email Dispatch:** It calls the Exchange API to send the HTML email. This process includes extracting embedded images from the HTML and attaching specified files.
6. **Result Handling:** The action returns a success message if the email is sent successfully or a failure message with error details if an exception occurs.
